subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR or replace it with a fresh narrow same-repo fix for this Telegram approval cleanup?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the issue is linked to an open fork PR that is conflicting and targets removed code, so ClawSweeper should not queue a competing fix until the landing path is chosen.

options.title: Replace with a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Close or abandon the obsolete fork PR and land a focused change against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt and rework the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork PR, drop unrelated docs churn, and move the fix to the current native approval runtime.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue paired to the existing conflicting fork PR, accepting that no clean current-main fix is queued yet.

recommendation.title: Replace with a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close or abandon the obsolete fork PR and land a focused change against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with tests and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current native approval lifecycle and are the clearest history owner for the final-action boundary.
